cast: SPINE thesis. Refrain: "Everything else is up to you. It only has to fly.". Features: mira, mira-brother, pip, bea, ana, sam, the-plane-shed, the-throwing-arm. Mira and Tomas fold paper planes for every kid on the street, and no two kids want the same thing. They cannot make a plane that is both what somebody asked for and a plane that actually flies, until they get a helper that already knows why things fly and only has to be taught how to fold.
